subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should an externally maintained Even Hub glasses client become a canonical Gateway setup-code bootstrap identity, and if so which generation-stable wire id should OpenClaw support?
rationale: The code is focused and well proven, but current main and the discussion do not establish authorization policy for promoting this external app into the silent-bootstrap allowlist or committing to its permanent exported client id.

options.title: Keep owner approval for now
options.body: Do not merge the canonical silent-bootstrap entry until maintainers sponsor Even Hub as a first-party or otherwise trusted companion; the external app continues using ordinary owner-approved pairing.

options.title: Approve a generalized identity
options.body: Sponsor the bounded bootstrap seam and rename the wire id to a durable Even Hub identity before merge, updating the external app in lockstep.

options.title: Approve the G2 identity
options.body: Accept `openclaw-even-g2-node` as the generation-specific canonical id and merge the existing bounded-profile behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep owner approval for now
recommendation.body: Do not merge the canonical silent-bootstrap entry until maintainers sponsor Even Hub as a first-party or otherwise trusted companion; the external app continues using ordinary owner-approved pairing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the current mobile bootstrap profile and the pairing subsystem, covering the two policy surfaces requiring a decision.
